posts.title: Bypassing iron-proxy's MCP Tool Allowlist With a Content-Type Header
posts.description: iron-proxy is an egress proxy to manage traffic for untrusted workloads. It works as a MITM proxy, has a DNS server and can apply an allowlist on MCP tool calls. While trying to sandbox an agent with docker, I added iron-proxy as a container to route all the traffic through it.
